entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:2
segments: These blessings; the blessings enumerated in

. 
 
No tongue can express nor finite mind conceive the number, greatness, variety, richness, or duration of the blessings which flow from obeying God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:7
segments: Seven; used for many.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:10
segments: Called; Jehovah's people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:15
segments: The miseries comprehended in the curses which flow from continued disobedience to God, as much surpass all finite conception as the blessings which flow from his favor.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:23
segments: Be brass, and--iron; the heaven would not give any more rain than if it were brass, nor the earth yield any more fruit than if it were iron.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:24
segments: As all the elements are under the control of God, he can at any time arm them against his foes, and pursue them with wrath till they perish.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:26
segments:
Thy carcass shall be meat; many of their dead bodies would be left unburied. 
 
  Fray; frighten, scare.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:27
segments: Botch; painful ulcers.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:28
segments: Diseases of body and mind are God's servants.  They go and come at his bidding, and fasten their deadly fangs on such as he commissions them to torment and destroy.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:32
segments:
No might; no power to escape the evils or to prevent them. 
 
Few calamities are more dreadful than to see the misery of children and be unable to help them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:40
segments: Cast his fruit; it would drop off unripe.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:42
segments: Thy trees; their leaves.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:45
segments: What renders calamities vastly more dreadful is, a conviction that we by our own wickedness have occasioned them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:46
segments: For ever; so long as they should continue as a people to transgress his commands.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:48
segments: A yoke of iron; afflict them with grievous bondage.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:49
segments: Swift as the eagle; rapid in their conquests.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:57
segments: The horrors of famine can be but faintly conceived; and if the sufferings occasioned by sin are so great in this world, what must thy be in the world to come?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:63
segments: Plucked from off the land; they were by the Romans carried off from their land and scattered among all nations; and were forbidden again to come within sight of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:67
segments: The history of the Jews for more than eighteen hundred years demonstrates the truth of the predictions contained in this chapter, and conclusively proves that in uttering them Moses spoke by the direction, and under the guidance of the Holy Ghost.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 28:68
segments: Ye shall be sold--and no man shall buy you; many were sold into perpetual bondage, and many more were offered for sale for whom their conquerors could not find a market, so great were their numbers; and multitudes were slain or left to perish.
